# hpe_morpheus_storage_server (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Storage Server resource.




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the storage server.
- `type` (String) The storage type code or ID.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the storage server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the storage server is enabled.
- `service_password` (String, Sensitive) The service password for the storage server.
- `service_url` (String) The service URL of the storage server.
- `service_username` (String, Sensitive) The service username for the storage server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the storage server.
